observations.content: Civil Appeal No. 57 of 1951 arises from a judgment of the High Court of East Punjab affirming a single judge's decision dismissing objections to the execution of a money decree.
observations.event: Filing of Civil Appeal challenging the affirmation of dismissal of execution objections.
observations.procedure_and_court: Civil Appeal before Supreme Court; prior proceedings in High Court of East Punjab and Senior Subordinate Judge, Ambala.

observations.content: On September 30, 1925, Baldev Das, manager of a joint Hindu family, executed a mortgage bond for Rs 16,000 in favor of Mst. Naraini and Talok Chand.
observations.event: Execution of mortgage bond over joint family movable properties.
observations.procedure_and_court: Private transaction; no court proceeding at this stage.

observations.content: On April 16, 1928, the appellants and a minor brother sued their father Baldev Das for partition of joint family properties, resulting in a final decree on July 20, 1928.
observations.event: Filing and conclusion of partition suit leading to division of joint family properties.
observations.procedure_and_court: Suit No. 23 of 1928 in Court of Subordinate Judge, Shahjahanpur.

observations.content: On September 29, 1934, Mst. Naraini filed a suit against Baldev Das for recovery of Rs 12,500 based on the 1925 mortgage bond.
observations.event: Filing of suit for recovery of money based on mortgage bond.
observations.procedure_and_court: Suit in Court of Senior Subordinate Judge, Ambala.

observations.content: On December 18, 1934, appellants applied to be added as party defendants, asserting Baldev Das was not the manager and properties had been partitioned.
observations.event: Application to be added as party defendants in mortgage recovery suit.
observations.procedure_and_court: Proceedings in Senior Subordinate Judge, Ambala.

observations.content: On February 7, 1935, plaintiff's counsel stated client would abandon claim against mortgaged property and seek only money decree against Baldev Das personally.
observations.event: Amendment of plaint to abandon claim against mortgaged property.
observations.procedure_and_court: Court proceedings in Senior Subordinate Judge, Ambala.

observations.content: Upon plaintiff's amendment, appellants withdrew their application to be added as parties but reserved right to take legal action if necessary.
observations.event: Withdrawal of application to be added as party defendants.
observations.procedure_and_court: Court proceedings in Senior Subordinate Judge, Ambala.

observations.content: On April 17, 1935, Baldev Das died; on September 2, appellants and their mother were brought on record as legal representatives.
observations.event: Death of Baldev Das and substitution of legal representatives.
observations.procedure_and_court: Court proceedings in Senior Subordinate Judge, Ambala.

observations.content: On October 9, 1935, appellants filed written statement alleging Baldev Das engaged in speculative transactions and debt was illegal and immoral.
observations.event: Filing of written statement raising plea of illegality and immorality of debt.
observations.procedure_and_court: Court proceedings in Senior Subordinate Judge, Ambala.

observations.content: On October 9, 1935, court recorded order that since plaintiff abandoned mortgage claim, legal representatives could not raise pleas on validity of mortgage.
observations.event: Court order restricting legal representatives from raising mortgage validity pleas.
observations.procedure_and_court: Court proceedings in Senior Subordinate Judge, Ambala.

observations.content: On November 20, 1935, parties compromised; simple money decree passed against estates of Baldev Das in hands of legal representatives for Rs 425 annas odd.
observations.event: Compromise and passing of money decree against estate of Baldev Das.
observations.procedure_and_court: Court proceedings in Senior Subordinate Judge, Ambala.

observations.content: After unsuccessful execution attempts, decree holder filed execution application on March 13, 1945; court directed attachment of shops in appellants' possession.
observations.event: Filing of execution application and attachment of appellants' properties.
observations.procedure_and_court: Execution proceedings in Senior Subordinate Judge, Ambala.

observations.content: On April 23, 1945, appellants filed objections under Section 47 CPC, arguing attached properties were their separate post-partition shares, not Baldev Das's estate.
observations.event: Filing of objections to execution of decree against appellants' separate properties.
observations.procedure_and_court: Execution proceedings in Senior Subordinate Judge, Ambala.

observations.content: Appellants asserted attached properties could not be liable for decretal dues as decree was against Baldev Das's estate, not their separate post-partition shares.
observations.event: Assertion that attached properties are not liable for father's pre-partition debt.
observations.procedure_and_court: Execution proceedings in Senior Subordinate Judge, Ambala.

observations.content: Subordinate Judge concluded there was a 1928 partition; properties attached were allotted to sons; decree was for pre-partition debt, thus sons' shares are liable under Hindu law.
observations.event: Judgment dismissing objections to execution based on Hindu law and CPC Section 53.
observations.procedure_and_court: Execution proceedings in Senior Subordinate Judge, Ambala.

observations.content: Since no plea of immorality was raised, objections under Section 47 CPC were dismissed; appellants appealed to High Court.
observations.event: Dismissal of objections under Section 47 CPC and filing of appeal to High Court.
observations.procedure_and_court: Execution proceedings in Senior Subordinate Judge, Ambala; appeal to High Court of East Punjab.

observations.content: High Court single judge (Rahman J.) dismissed appellants' appeal and affirmed Subordinate Judge's decision.

participants.role: Rahman J., High Court of East Punjab

observations.event: Dismissal of first appeal by High Court single judge.
observations.procedure_and_court: Appeal before High Court of East Punjab (single judge).

observations.content: Further appeal to Letters Patent Bench (Division Bench) was also dismissed; current appeal challenges propriety of Letters Patent Bench judgment.

participants.role: Letters Patent Bench, High Court of East Punjab

observations.event: Dismissal of second appeal by Letters Patent Bench; filing of current Civil Appeal.
observations.procedure_and_court: Appeal before Letters Patent Bench, High Court of East Punjab; current appeal before Supreme Court.

observations.content: Mr. Kunzru contended decreeholder can proceed only against Baldev Das's properties; appellants' properties cannot be liable.
observations.event: First contention in current appeal: Decree limited to Baldev Das's estate.
observations.procedure_and_court: Civil Appeal No. 57 of 1951 before Supreme Court.

observations.content: Second contention: Post-partition separate property of sons not liable under Hindu law for father's pre-partition debt.
observations.event: Second contention in current appeal: Hindu law does not make sons' separate property liable.
observations.procedure_and_court: Civil Appeal No. 57 of 1951 before Supreme Court.

observations.content: Third contention: Even if pious obligation exists, it can only be enforced in a suit, not via execution of decree obtained against father alone.
observations.event: Third contention in current appeal: Pious obligation enforceable only in suit, not execution.
observations.procedure_and_court: Civil Appeal No. 57 of 1951 before Supreme Court.

observations.content: Decree ordered payment against 'estate of Baldev Das deceased in possession of his legal representatives' including Rs 425-7-0 half costs.
observations.event: Passing of compromise decree against estate of Baldev Das.
observations.procedure_and_court: Court proceedings in Senior Subordinate Judge, Ambala.

observations.content: No formal compromise petition filed; two statements on record set out compromise terms matching decree wording.
observations.event: Recording of compromise terms via statements rather than formal petition.
observations.procedure_and_court: Court proceedings in Senior Subordinate Judge, Ambala.

observations.content: Expression 'estate of Baldev Das deceased' refers to property belonging to Baldev Das at death, excluding sons' post-partition shares.
observations.event: Argument on interpretation of 'estate of Baldev Das deceased' in decree.
observations.procedure_and_court: Civil Appeal No. 57 of 1951 before Supreme Court.
